sam: quick follow-up from the handshake discussions — spotted a gap: delegated features (e.g., hosted-kms-proxy) need clear ACK semantics so callers don't proceed with partial assumptions.
anya: agree. i'm thinking an explicit ACK step after handshake when adapter grants a proxy-based ceiling. otherwise clients might start uploads before proxy is ready.
lee: concrete flow: 1) initial handshake returns granted+fallback_hint; 2) if fallback_hint=="hosted-kms-proxy" client must call `feature_ack(feature='kms_proxy')` which returns OK/RETRY/FAIL with ttl. SDK should retry with exponential backoff using provided ttl.
marco: sounds good. add a `ready_at` timestamp in ACK to avoid raceconds, and include `proxy_endpoint` + cert thumbprint for secure comms. we need to keep handshake light though — make ACK optional unless feature flagged as "delegated_requires_ack" in manifest.
ci-bot: note: 1 new test added to matrices/features: delegated-ack-timeout.flaky -> triggered on PR #1123 :white_check_mark:
sam: edgecases: what if adapter grants but later revokes entitlement mid-flight? recommend server emits `feature_revoked` event and client receives 401/403 on subsequent attempts. SDKs should expose `on('feature_revoked')` so apps can surface actionable UI.
anya: also consider bulk requests: when a batch contains mixes of granted/denied features, how should SDK behave? propose per-item feature enforcement and a top-level `X-Feature-Envelope` header describing per-item result. apps can then retry only failed items.
lee: observability: always emit `feature_path` metric tag: one of [manifest, runtime_probe, ack]. correlate with latency. ops should be able to pivot alerts if high % of calls depend on ack flow (indicates slow proxy).
marco: security: ACK responses must be bound to token scopes. don't return proxy_endpoint unless token is valid and tenant entitled. otherwise return `ENTITLEMENT_MISSING` with upgrade_url. make sure proxy endpoints are short-lived.
sam: i'll write a tiny RFC snippet showing handshake+ack protos, SDKs changes (client.capabilities.ack(feature)), and a simple state diagram. target for review this sprint. thanks.
